meta.description: A substrate to grow mushrooms on, a scanned mesh in real size baked into the node: a stump with the forest floor around it, a cushion of moss, pine needle litter or leaf litter. sample_mesh gives points on it where stipes can start, join_meshes shows it with the mushrooms.

substrate.label: Substrate
substrate.description: stump: a pine stump about 33 cm across on a mound of forest floor, 56 cm across. moss: a cushion of moss and forest floor, 23 cm across. needles: pine needle litter, 29 cm across. leaves: leaf litter with twigs, 29 cm across. Each sits on y = 0 at its rim, centred on the axis

colored.label: Colored
colored.description: Off leaves the colors of the scan out, the viewer shows the substrate in its own material, so the mushrooms stand out
